name: Richmond Hill
description: Bus complement to the Richmond Hill rail corridor. Earlier buses ended at Richmond Hill GO; later service reached Gormley and Bloomington. The 2005 table also contains shorter Leslie Street services.

timeline.event: The timetable documents Richmond Hill–Langstaff–Union buses, Richmond Hill–Union expresses, and Leslie/Old Cummer–Leslie/401–Union trips.
The route family had reached Gormley; the timetable displays branches 61 and 61A through 61F.
Branches 61A, 61B, 61C and 61F were withdrawn in the September restructuring.
Bloomington GO opened with weekday route 61 bus service.
The timetable shows the Bloomington–Gormley–Richmond Hill–Langstaff–Union corridor and the Richmond Hill short service.

gaps: Detailed Gormley-era lettered patterns should be read from the original 2019 timetable; a modern letter must not be assigned retroactively to a 2005 trip.
These are documented dated snapshots. Changes between snapshots, temporary diversions and every historical local stop have not all been recovered.

GTFS dates identify captured feeds, not necessarily the first or last day of a route. Open a pattern to see its exact scheduled service dates. Temporary rail replacement and special-service patterns are included when present in the source.
Manually reconstructed versions generally contain published timetable timing points / major stops. They must not be read as complete roadside stop inventories.
